slide.text: Welcome to KnucklsOS — your Windows 11–style gaming operating system.
Steam, Lutris, Wine and Proton-GE come preinstalled. Sign in to Steam, enable Steam Play for all titles, and just press Play.
Most Windows games run great out of the box. A few competitive titles with kernel-level anti-cheat may not work — everything else just does.
Your GPU driver is detected automatically on first boot. For NVIDIA, the recommended driver is installed for you.
KnucklsOS — made by Shaun. Powered by Ubuntu & KDE Plasma.
